_doc: Move effects from the PMD Origins RawAsset dump (docs/PMD_FX.md). fx = effect sheets, beams = stretched beams, moves = which effect plays on the user / rides the projectile / plays on hit / draws a beam. moves.<id>.look = procedural show drawn on top by gfx/move_show.gd (all optional, defaults come from kind/type): cast [aura, icon, shield, heal, charge, sound, hearts, notes, sparkles, spin, smoke, glow, stomp, wind, flames, dance, metal, emanate, dust, rain, zone_here, gravity, storm, powder, feathers, splash, beam_down, shatter] at the user on cast; swing (arc/multi_arc, or on hit for dashes) [slash, claw, x, fang, fist, chop, kick, tail, slap, jab, horn, sting, wing, hearts, rough, pellets, burst]; trail (dash) = a type name or [speed, spin, fire, water, spark]; ghosts = afterimages; proj = projectile trail (type name, fire, spark, sparkle, heart, note, glow, smoke, water, wind, none); orb = icon/glow riding the projectile; pre (aoe_target before it lands) [cloud, rocks, meteor, powder, notes, glow, hearts, sparkles, swirl]; land (aoe lands) [quake, burst, ring, rocks, powder, notes, pillar, splash, vortex, hearts, sparkles, fire, sludge, flash, sound, bolt, shock, spikes, dust, petals, edges, cloud]; zone [vortex, fire, sand, water, cloud, petals, spikes, grass, sparkles]; impact (on hit) [dust, crater, drain, splash, sparks, stars, pillar, fire, shock, or any swing/land name]; status_hit (status projectile that connects) [flash, hearts, icon, cloud, web, sparks, rings, fire, pmd, or a land name]; to_targets (emanate) [hearts, notes, feathers, sparkles, glare, sound, smoke, wind]; icon [heart, note, moon, star, arrow, spike, fang, claw, shield, swords, wings, heal, drop, flame, flower, swirl, snow, rocks, bolt, fist]; color [r,g,b] overrides the type color; size scales swings; dur = shield/zone_here seconds; spore = PMD spore sheet for powders; rocks = how many fall.

scratch.note: three claw marks; Dir1 = rotate to the aim

chatter.note: chatting lines over the head (N07d picnic)

discharge_hit.note: electric discharge ring on the target

emote_exclaim.note: surprised '!' above the head (N07d picnic chatter)

emote_question.note: curious '?' above the head (N07d picnic chatter)

growl.note: sound wave growl; Dir8 row = aim

power_whip_hit_front.note: vine whip impact burst; frames 0-7 used, 8-11 are empty

rage.note: red anger burst on the user

sing_notes.note: music notes floating up (the grove rite's sing)

twin_needle.note: double stinger jab; Dir8 row = aim

vine_whip.note: vine lash; Dir1 = rotate to the aim

wave_circle_pink.note: pink hypnotic wave; Dir5 row = aim

wave_circle_white.note: white sound wave; Dir5 row = aim

wave_circle_yellow.note: yellow electric wave; Dir5 row = aim

wind_leaves.note: leaves swirling in the wind (stream trail)

wide_slash.note: wide claw slash; Dir8 row = aim

hydro_pump.note: pressurised water jet; Dir1 = rotate to aim

charge_beam_glow.note: solid white-gold charge glow, grows through the windup

lightning.note: Head = strike flash on the ground (drawn 1.5x so the impact reads), Body (32x128) tiles up the bolt, Tail empty

beam.note: Head = muzzle flare, Body (32x1) tiles along the beam, Tail (42x42) = burst at the far end

beam_pink.note: pink psychic beam (same geometry as Beam, pink palette)

beam_ice.note: icy beam (same geometry as Beam, ice palette)

beam_yellow.note: electric beam (same geometry as Beam, yellow palette)

beam_purple.note: purple meteor beam (same geometry as Beam, violet palette)

solar_beam.note: fat white-gold sun beam: gold body + soft additive glow + white-hot core

water.note: Hydro Pump: a pressurised PMD water jet -- the Hydro_Pump_RSE sheet tiled along the beam (blue/white churn) over a cyan halo and white core, Beam muzzle/tail tinted blue; Blastoise fires its two shell cannons as two converging jets
